title: 第三章 魔门作风第四章 入阴阳殿
content_zh:
苏阎将手中的黑铁令牌收好，随即偏过头，视线扫过院内。
原本死气沉沉的杂役们，正拼命往墙角缩。
十几号人挤成一团，硬生生空出了一大片空地。
没人敢直视他。
就在半个时辰前，他们都还是一样的血食，一样的待宰羔羊。
但现在，地上的三具尸体，尤其是王管事那具肥硕的身躯，成了横亘在他们之间无法跨越的天堑。
畏惧。
这种源自本能的战栗，比任何言语都来得直接。
他们都在害怕苏阎，害怕自己下一刻就会跟躺在地上的那三具尸体一样。
苏阎收回目光，懒得理会这些昔日的同伴。
修仙界，尤其是万骨宗这种魔道宗门，同情心连喂狗都不配。
他盘腿坐下，闭目调息。
刚掠夺来的炼气一层修为还需要他花费一些时间去适应。
脑海中，《阴阳赋》的残卷口诀逐字浮现。
这是一门靠采补气血与元阴元阳来精进修为的邪功，王管事之前想对那少女施展的，便是这门功法的皮毛。
约莫半柱香的功夫。
院外传来不急不缓的脚步声，脚踩在碎石子上，发出沙沙的声响。
来人推开破烂的院门。
是个穿着黑色道袍的青年。
他的面容白净，透着几分病态的苍白，腰间挂着个精致的黑皮葫芦。

黑袍道人迈过门槛，目光直接锁定了盘坐在地的苏阎，又瞥了眼地上的尸体。
“苏阎？”青年冷声开口。
苏阎起身，拍了拍灰尘，拱手行礼：“见过师兄。”
青年上下打量着苏阎，半晌，他笑了一声，露出森白的牙齿。
“我叫李言，内门三峰弟子。今日轮到我当值，负责接引新晋外门。”李言走近两步，鼻尖耸动，在嗅空气中的血腥味，“来之前我看过你的卷宗。三年前被抓上山，分到这丁字号杂役院。”
李言顿了顿，语气里多了几分玩味：“这鬼地方，被当做血食的凡人，通常活不过十个月。你不仅熬了整整三年，还抓住机会反咬一口，宰了个炼气一层的废物。”
“你很不错，是个天生的魔修胚子。”
苏阎没有接话，只保持着拱手的姿势。
言多必失，在这个吃人的宗门里，谨慎是活命的第二法则。
李言对苏阎的沉默并不反感，反而越发满意。
魔门不需要夸夸其谈的蠢货，只要咬人够狠的疯狗。
“行了，别杵着了。既然拿了令牌，从今往后你就是我万骨宗外门弟子。跟我走吧，去阴阳殿点卯。”李言转身欲走，忽然脚步微顿，又转过头来，“按宗门规矩，新晋弟子可挑选一名杂役作为随从，负责起居杂役。”
“刚好就在杂役院了，你便从他们当中挑选一个吧。”
选随从？
苏阎转过身，目光投向缩在墙角的那群人。
只是被他视线扫中，那群杂役便骇得连连后退，有几个胆小的直接尿了裤子，骚臭味混杂着血腥味弥漫开来。
他们亲眼看着苏阎用一根骨头捅穿了王管事的喉咙，又看到他轻而易举的杀了王管事的那两个随从，谁敢跟着这个杀神？
content_en:
Su Yan put away the black iron token in his hand, then turned his head and scanned the courtyard.
The servants, who were originally lifeless, were shrinking back into the corners desperately.
More than a dozen people huddled together, leaving a large open space.
No one dared to look directly at him.
Just half an hour ago, they all had the same blood meal and the same lamb to be slaughtered.
But now, the three corpses on the ground, especially the fat body of Manager Wang, have become an insurmountable chasm between them.
fear.
This tremor originating from instinct is more direct than any words.
They were all afraid of Su Yan, afraid that they would be like the three corpses lying on the ground in the next moment.
Su Yan withdrew his gaze, too lazy to pay attention to these former companions.
In the world of immortality, especially demonic sects like the Ten Thousand Bones Sect, the compassion is not even worthy of feeding a dog.
He sat cross-legged, closed his eyes and adjusted his breath.
It would take him some time to get used to the level of Qi refining he had just plundered.
In my mind, the formulas of the fragments of "Yin Yang Fu" appeared word by word.
This is an evil technique that relies on replenishing qi and blood and Yuanyin and Yuanyang to improve one's cultivation. What Manager Wang wanted to use on the girl before was just the beginning of this technique.
It takes about half a stick of incense.
There was the sound of unhurried footsteps outside the courtyard, and the feet made a rustling sound on the gravel.
The visitor pushed open the broken courtyard door.
He is a young man wearing a black robe.
His face was fair and somewhat sickly pale, and a delicate black leather gourd hung around his waist.
The black-robed Taoist stepped across the threshold, his eyes directly locked on Su Yan who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, and then glanced at the corpse on the ground.
"Su Yan?" The young man said coldly.
Su Yan stood up, dusted himself off, raised his hands and saluted: "I've met my senior brother."
The young man looked Su Yan up and down. After a while, he laughed, revealing his white teeth.
"My name is Li Yan, a disciple of the Three Peaks of the Inner Sect. It's my turn to be on duty today, responsible for welcoming the new recruits to the Outer Sect." Li Yan took two steps closer, his nose twitching, smelling the smell of blood in the air. "I read your file before coming here. You were captured and sent to the mountain three years ago, and you were assigned to this D-number house."
Li Yan paused, and his tone became a little more playful: "In this damn place, mortals who are treated as blood food usually don't live more than ten months. Not only did you survive for three full years, you also seized the opportunity to bite back and kill a waste at the first level of Qi Refining."
"You are very good, you are a born demon cultivator."
Su Yan didn't answer, just kept the gesture of cupping his hands.
Too much talk leads to mistakes. In this cannibal sect, caution is the second rule of survival.
Li Yan was not disgusted with Su Yan's silence, but became more and more satisfied with it.
The Demon Sect does not need a boastful idiot, only a mad dog that bites hard enough.
"Okay, don't hold back. Now that you have taken the token, from now on you are an outer disciple of my Ten Thousand Bones Sect. Come with me and go to the Yin and Yang Palace to do the crotch." Li Yan turned around to leave, but suddenly paused and turned his head again, "According to the sect's rules, new disciples can choose a handyman as a follower to be responsible for daily chores."
"They happen to be in the courtyard, so you can choose one of them."
Choose a follower?
Su Yan turned around and looked at the group of people huddled in the corner.
Just by being caught by his gaze, the group of handymen were so horrified that they backed away. A few timid ones peed their pants directly, and the stench mixed with the smell of blood filled the air.
They watched with their own eyes as Su Yan stabbed Steward Wang's throat with a bone, and saw him easily kill Steward Wang's two followers. Who would dare to follow this god of murder?
